claims.measure: Incurred hurricane catastrophe losses, including defense and cost containment expenses
claims.period: year ended December 31, 2012 (Sandy losses incurred in the fourth quarter)
claims.basis: No recoveries from primary catastrophe reinsurance treaties during this period. Includes defense and cost containment expenses; excludes adjusting and other claims settlement expenses.
claims.source_chain: The local MD&A and filing-wide scale conventions are USD thousands. The preceding narrative uniquely assigns the exact 7,977 Q4 loss to Superstorm Sandy. The 2012 hurricane/tropical-storm cell is also 7,977, unlike 2,355 wind/hail and the 10,332 all-event total. The 2011 same-row value predates Sandy. The catastrophe-definition threshold is not the tax basis of the specific amount.
